title: Todo app sample
_comment: The sample demo made with demo-studio: a public todo app (TodoMVC, React), three scenes. zoom = [factor, centerX, centerY, startSec, durationSec] in 1920x1080 coords of the output clip; trim = [inSec, outSec] of the raw clip.

sequence.title: A todo list in three moves.
sequence.subtitle: Recorded and cut with demo-studio.
sequence.voiceover: A todo list should take seconds. Type what needs doing and press Enter.

sequence.caption: Tick things off. Filter what is left.
sequence.voiceover: Tick things off as you finish them. Filters show what is still active and what is done.

sequence.caption: Clear the finished ones in one click.
sequence.voiceover: Clear the finished ones in one click.
